overview_description.description: Esarwa is an AI-powered modular ERP overlay that helps enterprises modernize legacy systems without costly rip-and-replace implementations. Instead of replacing entire ERPs, Esarwa deploys targeted modules to fix workflow gaps across finance, supply chain, CRM, inventory and operations. The platform integrates with existing systems to deliver faster deployment, cleaner operational data and measurable ROI. Esarwa serves SMEs and enterprise clients across India and the GCC across industries such as manufacturing, retail, logistics and hospitality.
